summary: No new receipt and no concrete sourced suspicion left to test, so I am holding the record unchanged rather than inventing work: validation reports the submission as valid with no_change and no execution requested. The account stands as one root cause with an execution-confirmed trigger (RestoreCommittedLogs with a commit-tracking store, newest configuration entry at or below the persisted commit index, no covering snapshot — confirmed in both directions by the shallow boundary case and its repeat), a source-traced mechanism (replayed-prefix scan bound, configuration installed into commitment on append, conflicting suffix cleared on term mismatch), four executed consequence classes with controls (missing membership context and cluster-wide plus live-quorum loss of electability; silent single-change voter drop; resurrected removed voter; forgotten added voter with understated quorum), the safety violation (concurrent leaders, truncation of the committed entry, divergent FSM state, and an acknowledged write surviving only on the node that lost the entry), the client-contract consequence (leadership confirmed while another majority elects a higher-term leader), the repair paths with their reachability boundary, six reproducibility repeats, three durable knowledge entries, negative results recorded (snapshot selection, captured documentation, file-snapshot durability, the impossible direct route in the two-server-change gap), and no open gaps.
